title: Absolute moments of sign deviations
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\{-1,1\}$. For any real $p$, write $a=\mathbb{P}_{x\sim\pi}(f(x)=1)$ and $b=\mathbb{P}_{x\sim\pi}(f(x)=-1)$. Then
\[\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}\bigl[|f(x)-\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi}f(y)|^p\bigr]=a(2b)^p+b(2a)^p.\]
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
